//: Markup-fidelity fixture for the GRID row container (svelte layout/Grid.svelte, keen Grid.grid/1). SCOPE = CONTAINER ONLY. Core's flex grid row is `<div class="pc-row">` (foundation class from @keenmate/pure-css, see snippets/grid.html). NOTE the `pc-` prefix (foundation-owned), not `pa-`. The row block carries alignment + gutter modifiers; its CHILDREN are columns (`pc-col-*`), modelled by the SEPARATE `column` fixture — here the body is plain slot text so the diff checks only the container's tag + class + nesting. The `.pc-row--*` modifiers claimed below are exactly the set in main.css: no-gutter, center, end, between, around, top, middle, bottom, stretch, same-height. Gap spacing is the shared `gap-*` utility (reachable via the class passthrough), not a `pc-row` modifier — out of scope. See accent-grid.json / section.json for the container-only model.

propsVocabulary.noGutter: boolean — remove the horizontal gutter between columns (pc-row--no-gutter)
propsVocabulary.sameHeight: boolean — force .pa-card inside each column to equal height (pc-row--same-height)
propsVocabulary.justify: horizontal alignment of columns center|end|between|around → pc-row--{justify}
propsVocabulary.valign: vertical alignment of columns top|middle|bottom|stretch → pc-row--{valign} (stretch is the explicit default)
propsVocabulary.body: the row's content area — plain slot text here (real children are pc-col columns)
propsVocabulary.extraClass: extra classes appended verbatim (class passthrough — not a core feature)

goldenConventions: Structural only. Base is always `<div class="pc-row">`; a modifier class is added per set feature. The body slot is a plain text token (Columns) so the diff checks the container's tag + class + nesting, not rich column content. Class-token order + whitespace are normalized away, so goldens are written for readability.

features.//: Feature→class contract authored from dist/css/main.css. The full .pc-row--* set in main.css is exactly: no-gutter, center, end, between, around, top, middle, bottom, stretch, same-height (10) — all claimed below (justify covers center/end/between/around; valign covers top/middle/bottom/stretch; noGutter + sameHeight cover the remaining two). Base `.pc-row` exists as a real rule. `produces: null` only for the slot + class passthrough.

extraClass.note: class passthrough — appended verbatim, not a core feature

cssStateClasses.//: All 10 pc-row--* modifiers are feature-driven; none are JS-toggled state classes.

deferred.//: The row's column children (`pc-col-*`, `pc-offset-*`, `pc-col--*`) belong to the SEPARATE `column` component, modelled by column.json — not elements of the pc-row block (they don't match `pc-row--*`/`pc-row__*`), so capability.mjs never reads them as part of this container's surface. Nothing to defer: the pc-row block has no sub-element classes of its own.

scenarios.name: combined
scenarios.note: Stacks gutter + same-height + justify + valign; class-token order is normalized away.

scenarios.name: extra-class
scenarios.note: Class passthrough appended after the component classes.
